gettingStarted.name: Getting started
gettingStarted.description: A quick tour of the essentials: creating a project, drawing, layers and saving.

newProject.title: Create a project
newProject.description: This is where you create a new canvas, picking a size or a preset (pixel art, HD, A4).

brush.title: The brush
brush.description: Your main tool for drawing. Size, hardness, opacity and spacing are all configurable further down this bar.

paintbucket.title: Paint bucket
paintbucket.description: Fills an area with the active color or pattern — also try patterns and gradients from the Asset Library.

selection.title: Selection
selection.description: Marks off an area of the canvas so other changes only affect that part.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Organize your drawing into independent layers — like stacked transparent sheets you can reorder, hide or blend.

undo.title: Undo and redo
undo.description: Everything you do stays in the history — don't hesitate to experiment, you can always go back.

save.title: Save your project
save.description: Saves the whole project (layers, animation, everything) to a file you can reopen later.

export.title: Export your work
export.description: Choose between PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF or SVG. The SVG is the flattened image wrapped in an SVG file, not editable vector art — this app works in pixels.
